what: Page-end strip — while scrolling one more screen height, the panel opens from the bottom (clip-path inset 100%→0, the panel follows down by the same distance so it seems to stay in place) and a progress ring in the center fills. On reaching the end it moves to the next page (after the fx:scroll-next-reveal event, via href)

options.href: Destination URL — if empty, only fires the event
options.go: Whether to wrap around when reaching the end, default true (if false, only the ring fills)
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Opening panel (child, pinned to screen height)
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: (if any) progress ring — pathLength="100" The svg circle. stroke-dashoffset goes from 100→0
options.fx:scroll-next-reveal: Event fired from the strip just before moving on — preventDefault stops the move (when you style the page-transition cover yourself)

use: ……
note: When opened with an automation tool (navigator.webdriver) it does not advance even at the end — prevents a measuring tool scrolling to the page bottom from leaking to another page
